parts.name: ACSSR complete native controller shell with integral button tongue

notes: Component 0 is the assembled complete controller enclosure (2654 triangles = displaced components 1+2). One rigid -90 degree Z rotation and translation; no scaling/cuts/fills. Source covers only the controller (44.94 x 18.74 x 11.5 mm), not the 80 x 45 x 31 mm kit. SSR body and installed controller-to-SSR transform are photo/dimension-constrained reconstructions. Original integral tongue flexes only during external button actuation; exact rest vertices and normals restored.
